_what: ADVISORY FLOOR for scripts/file-line-citation-check.mjs, read by the `charter file:line citation drift` step of .github/workflows/seal-reading.yml. Per target, `unresolved` is the floor: a run ABOVE it warns (new drift, and the step names the new misses by diffing against a re-run at derived_at), a run BELOW it notices (repairs landed; lower the floor in the same PR as the repair). Nothing here fails a job. Turning it into a failing check is a separate later change, after the hand-repair slices of task-b881189fa7f7395d land.
derivation: one run per target at derived_at: node scripts/file-line-citation-check.mjs --charter <charter> --map <base>=<path> --json > file (NOT a pipe: the checker exits before a piped stdout drains and truncates at 65536 bytes); every count below is copied from that JSON, none typed. Slack is the checker default (+/-3). LOWERED 2026-09-24 by task-776e34f0e1f10330 (PR #20128) from the floor derived at 70e21ced4 (unresolved app.js 203, app.css 48, index.html 4, __app.test.mjs 55).
